title: black and decker toaster oven
text:
black and decker toaster oven. Daughter lives in Arizona and needed a new toaster oven. She chose this one for it's size. She reports that it arrived quickly and in good condition (I have prime). She reports that she likes it because it is deep (will take a 9x13 pan), but doesn't take up a lot of counter space. She also specifically wanted one with little "electronics".... she prefers "dials" as they don't break as often in her mind. (I have an "electronic" toaster oven I've had for nearly 5 years - so to each his own!)... It is simple to use and looks nice with her new stainless appliances. I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info be helpful. Further, I do NOT receive compensation of ANY kind for my honest reviews.
UPDATE.... 8/7/2016.... Wow. This toaster oven is HUGE. My daughter cooks full size pans and meals in this oven. The "up" side is that in Arizona, this toaster oven heats up the kitchen way less than the regular size gas oven. Trade off - it takes up some counter real estate and that's no lie. All that being said, my daughter says it is her favorite toaster oven yet. She is a very picky customer. I would add that for the price this toaster oven is really a bargain. Again, I do NOT receive compensation for my reviews of ANY kind.

features: Specially engineered to fit most 9" x13" pans with handles, eight pieces of bread, or a 12"  pizza.
Four Functions - Dedicated cooking functions include: convection bake, broil, toast, and keep warm.

description: The BLACK + DECKER Extra-Wide Toaster Oven simplifies large baking tasks. Its extended interior fits an entire 13"x9" pan, so you can bake lasagna, brownies, and even 12" frozen pizzas in no time. You won't have to wait around for your large oven to preheat anymore, just set the correct temperature and time and you'll be baking in minutes with four different functions: bake, broil, toast, and keep warm. Convection technology circulates air within the oven for fast and even results while baking. Plus, the external crumb tray is easy to slide in and out, making cleanup a breeze.
